messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Percent 5xx up from 0.3% -> 6.8% over last 3m. Autoscale engaged. Paging oncall.
Maria Gomez: saw the alert, I'm on call. any customer reports?
Raj Singh: yes, a handful of customers reported timeouts and 502s; support ticket queue shows spike.
Dan Park: I'm seeing a matching spike in gateway 504s in load-balancer logs. Latency tail up to 12s for many requests.
Maria Gomez: quick triage: service graphs show prefix-kv miss rate jumped ~x20 and eviction_rate spiked. Could be an eviction storm on prefix cache.
Infra Bot: metric snapshot: prefix_cache.evictions = 1.2M/min (normal ~30k/min), kv.read_latency_p95 = 420ms -> 1.8s, downstream model pool saturating.
Raj Singh: that eviction rate looks like a cascade. Any node-level OOMs or GC?
Dan Park: checking node metrics: a few nodes under high mem pressure, disk I/O spikes on shard-7, some RPC timeouts between prefix cache frontends and KV backends.
Maria Gomez: immediate mitigation: enable cache bypass for eu-west-1 route to fall back to direct KV read with backoff. Can we flip the routing rule?
Raj Singh: I can patch the routing policy to bypass cache for 10m and reduce concurrency to 60% for the region. Pushing config now.
Dan Park: deployed partial bypass. Rolling traffic gradually. Observability: 5xxs dropping from 6.8% -> 2.6% in 90s. Customers still seeing intermittent 502s though.
Maria Gomez: good. Next: identify root cause — logs show prefix checksum mismatch errors on many entries just before eviction spike: "checksum mismatch: expected 0x3f2a got 0x1b8c"
Raj Singh: hmm checksum mismatches => possible corruption during compaction or partial writes. Any recent compaction jobs?
Dan Park: there was a compaction job batch on shard-7 triggered by retention policy ~2m before incidents. Compaction logs show a few "write partial" errors and retries.
Infra Bot: incident correlation: compaction_job/retention-trigger/shard-7 @6123456600 had 14 transient write errors.
Maria Gomez: OK looks like compaction induced transient corruption -> eviction cascade as checksums failed -> entries removed -> cache missstorm -> backend thundering -> gateway timeouts.
Raj Singh: mitigation plan: 1) keep cache bypass for now, 2) throttle compaction jobs globally, 3) mark shard-7 read-only and schedule targeted rollback/repair, 4) notify customers on impacted requests.
Dan Park: implementing 1 and 2 now. Throttling compactions by 90% across region. Brought shard-7 to maintenance mode (read-only).
Maria Gomez: creating a short customer-facing blurb for support: "We're investigating elevated errors for text generation in EU region; temporary mitigation applied (cache bypass). Some requests may be slower. We're working on restoring normal service. ETA 60-90m."
Raj Singh: putting a pager duty escalation to SRE leads in 15m if metrics not back to baseline.
Infra Bot: status update: after bypass + compaction throttle, 5xx = 1.1%, latency p95 down to 850ms.
Dan Park: running a targeted scan on shard-7 to identify corrupted SSTs and compute checksums. Starting low-impact repair job.
Maria Gomez: log snippet for postmortem: ```
[6123456712] shard-7 compaction write error: write partial: bytes_written=4096/8192 err=EIO
[6123456713] prefix checksum mismatch: key=ns:prefix:abc123 expected=0x3f2a got=0x1b8c
[6123456720] eviction triggered for prefix=ns:prefix:abc123 reason=checksum_invalid
```
Raj Singh: good capture. Any customer impact numbers? How many requests failed?
Maria Gomez: support queue aggregate: ~4.2k failed requests across 3 customers in last 10m, top impacted customers flagged for proactive outreach.
Dan Park: repair job progress: scanned 45% of shard-7, found ~120k corrupted entries; most are expired/old prefixes. Starting compact+repair for remaining live keys.
Infra Bot: note: rolling compaction resumed with stricter write verification after 12:52 UTC.
Raj Singh: what's the rollback plan if repair worsens latency?
Maria Gomez: fallback: re-enable cache after repair in safe mode (verify checksums in reads) and route heavy customers to dedicated capacity if needed. Also consider restoring from snapshot if corruption proves extensive.
Dan Park: timeline: continue bypass + throttle; re-evaluate in 30m. If 5xx < 0.5% and latency p95 < 400ms we start controlled re-enable.
Maria Gomez: oncall handoff in 45m to night shift: Raj please take over if still active. I'll draft the handoff note with commands used.
Raj Singh: I got it. Adding runbook excerpt to thread.
Maria Gomez: runbook excerpt: ```
# temporary cache bypass (k8s config):
kubectl patch config route-policy -n infra --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/routes/eu-west-1/cachePolicy","value":"bypass"}]'
# throttle compactions (admin API):
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://infra.api/compaction/throttle -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","rate_pct":10}'
```
Dan Park: saved. Adding note to incident tracker with affected customers and metrics.
PagerDuty: Customer escalation created: PD-78913 assigned to SRE-leads.
Maria Gomez: final status update for now: mitigation applied, partial repair in progress, customer outreach started. Monitoring closely. Will update if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
Raj Singh: thanks everyone, continuing monitoring.
Oncall Bot: Incident channel will remain open; please add any logs or findings to the incident ticket.
